intro: Newk's Eatery is the Southern fast-casual chain built on made-to-order sandwiches, big salads, soups like the signature Lobster & Crab Bisque, and hand-pressed pizzas, all ordered at the counter and brought to your table. It is known for fresh ingredients, the famous Newk's Pickle, and a self-serve condiment bar. Below is the Newk's Eatery menu with representative prices for 2026.
quick_answer: At Newk's Eatery, sandwiches run about $9.50 to $12.50 (with kettle chips), whole salads $11.50 to $14.50, and a 10-inch hand-pressed pizza $10.50 to $13.50. Soups are about $4.50 to $7.50, and the Half & Half combo (half sandwich with a salad or soup) is $9.50 to $11.50. The Newk's Q, Newk's Favorite salad and the Lobster & Crab Bisque are the signatures.
hot_deal: Newk's Eatery value: the Half & Half combo ($9.50 to $11.50) is the best value, pairing a half sandwich with a salad or a cup of soup. A cup of soup ($4.50 to $5.50) is the cheapest single item, and kids meals are $6 to $7.50. Newk's Rewards drops occasional deals. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: How much is a sandwich at Newk's Eatery?
faqs.a: Sandwiches run about $9.50 to $12.50 and come with house-made kettle chips. The Half & Half combo, a half sandwich with a salad or cup of soup, is about $9.50 to $11.50 and is the most popular value option. Prices vary by location.

faqs.q: What is Newk's Eatery known for?
faqs.a: Newk's Eatery is a Southern fast-casual chain known for made-to-order sandwiches, big salads like the Newk's Favorite, its signature Lobster & Crab Bisque, hand-pressed pizzas, and the free Newk's Pickle. You order at the counter and it is brought to your table.

Yes. Newk's serves 10-inch hand-pressed pizzas, about $10.50 to $13.50, in varieties like four cheese, pepperoni, margherita and BBQ chicken. They are a popular alternative to the sandwiches and salads.
Newk's does not publish a full per-item calorie guide, so calories are not listed here rather than guessed. Totals depend on the sandwich, salad protein, soup and sides you choose, so dishes vary.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Newk's Eatery?
faqs.a: Favorites include The Newk's Q sandwich, the Newk's Favorite salad, the Lobster & Crab Bisque, the Half & Half combo, and the hand-pressed pizzas.
